nodes.label: Server.Run
nodes.desc: Server.Run (server.go L506) accepts TCP connections; newConn (L294) creates a clientConn per MySQL client; NewServer (L311) assembles the listener.

nodes.label: clientConn.Run
nodes.desc: clientConn.Run (conn.go L1157) is the per-connection packet loop, reading command packets and calling dispatch.

nodes.label: dispatch
nodes.desc: clientConn.dispatch (conn.go L1444) decodes the command byte; COM_QUERY falls through to handleQuery (L1864).

nodes.label: ExecStmt.Exec
nodes.desc: ExecStmt (adapter.go L392) bridges protocol and engine: Exec (L656) plans+runs a statement, buildExecutor (L1592) materializes the executor tree, handleNoDelay (L1075) handles non-SELECT statements.

nodes.label: session.ExecuteStmt
nodes.desc: session.ExecuteStmt (session.go L2489) with executeStmtImpl (L2500); session.Execute (L1947) runs raw SQL strings.

nodes.label: doCommit / doCommitWithRetry
nodes.desc: session.doCommit (session.go L540) prepares txn keys and locks; doCommitWithRetry (L817) retries the whole commit on conflicts; commitTxnWithTemporaryData (L709) handles temp-table commits.

nodes.label: tikvTxn — 2PC commit
nodes.desc: tikvTxn (txn_driver.go L47) adapts TiDB to the tikv/client-go transaction; the two-phase committer (prewrite/commit) lives in the client-go dependency.

nodes.label: Optimize
nodes.desc: Optimize (optimize.go L148) consults the non-prepared plan cache (getPlanFromNonPreparedPlanCache L69), then runs buildAndOptimizeLogicalPlanRound (L503) rounds before physical costing.

nodes.label: PlanBuilder.Build
nodes.desc: PlanBuilder.Build (planbuilder.go L601) dispatches per statement type to buildSelect, buildInsert, and friends.

nodes.label: buildSelect
nodes.desc: PlanBuilder.buildSelect (logical_plan_builder.go L4349) lowers a SELECT AST into a LogicalPlan tree of joins, selections and aggregations.

nodes.label: findBestTask
nodes.desc: findBestTask (find_best_task.go L604) does the cost-based physical selection; findBestTask4LogicalDataSource (L2260) picks TableReader vs IndexReader vs IndexLookUp access paths.

nodes.label: Histogram / Bucket
nodes.desc: Histogram (histogram.go L65) and Bucket (L103) hold column statistics that give findBestTask its row estimates.

nodes.label: executorBuilder
nodes.desc: newExecutorBuilder (builder.go L154); build (L195) switch-cases the physical plan into concrete executors.

nodes.label: Executor interface
nodes.desc: Executor (executor.go L51) requires Next (L63) to fill chunk batches; BaseExecutor (L356) provides shared plumbing.

nodes.label: PointGetExecutor
nodes.desc: PointGetExecutor (point_get.go L118) with Next (L304) serves single-key lookups straight from the txn buffer / snapshot — no full plan tree.

nodes.label: TableReaderExecutor
nodes.desc: TableReaderExecutor (table_reader.go L139): Open (L232) builds the DAG request, Next (L366) streams rows back from TiKV/TiFlash.

nodes.label: IndexReader / IndexLookUp
nodes.desc: IndexReaderExecutor (distsql.go L222) scans covering indexes; IndexLookUpExecutor (L502) fetches handles then double-reads rows.

nodes.label: SelectionExec
nodes.desc: SelectionExec (select.go L712) evaluates filter expressions row by row above the scan.

nodes.label: ProjectionExec
nodes.desc: ProjectionExec (projection.go L77) computes output expressions; Next (L202) evaluates them per chunk.

nodes.label: RequestBuilder
nodes.desc: RequestBuilder.Build (request_builder.go L61), SetDAGRequest (L203), SetHandleRanges (L156) and SetKeepOrder (L320) assemble the kv.Request sent to storage nodes.

nodes.label: distsql.Select
nodes.desc: Select (distsql.go L62) / SelectWithRuntimeStats (L174) start the coprocessor read and return a streaming SelectResult.

nodes.label: buildCopTasks
nodes.desc: copTask (coprocessor.go L291) is one region-scoped unit of work; buildCopTasks (L529) cuts key ranges by region cache.

nodes.label: copIterator
nodes.desc: copIterator (coprocessor.go L990) schedules tasks with bounded concurrency; Next (L1441) yields ResultSubsets.

nodes.label: MPPClient — TiFlash
nodes.desc: MPPClient (mpp.go L46) coordinates MPP plan fragments pushed down to the TiFlash columnar replicas.

nodes.label: tikvStore
nodes.desc: tikvStore (tikv_driver.go L327) implements the kv.Storage driver over tikv/client-go's RPC layer to PD + TiKV.

nodes.label: kv.Transaction / Snapshot / Storage
nodes.desc: Transaction (kv.go L264), Snapshot (L815) and Storage (L867) are the interfaces every storage engine backend implements.
